<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
In a Guild Wars 2 guild you add your own characters, and sign up by the role you are playing.

## Add your character

Open `/my-profile`, then the Guild Wars 2 tab, then **👤 My characters** and **➕ Add my character**. Give its **name**, its **profession**, and, if you like, your **account name** (Name.1234) and a logs link. Then open it and pick the **build** you play (the core profession or an elite specialization) and a second build if you have one. **✏️ Edit** holds a build link or a note.

## Sign up for a squad

Press the role you are playing tonight: **Tank**, **Healer**, **Support** (boons) or **DPS**. Alagos signs you up with your build in that role, on your main character first, then your alts. In the answer only you see, you can switch build or character; your role stays.

If your role is full you go on its **bench** and move up by yourself; Alagos tells you in a DM.
{% endraw %}
